capabilities: Sync Get Notes cloud notes, knowledge bases, blogger content, and live transcripts into the vault
Push and update local notes back to the cloud with conflict resolution and delete handling
Retrieve related cloud content through semantic (RAG) search in a sidebar panel
Import attachments by type and convert notes to Markdown with YAML frontmatter
Visualize imported notes in a Moments timeline and a Canvas graph
disambiguation: Despite the 'Importer' name, it is not a one-time import tool; it also supports ongoing two-way sync via the OpenAPI channel.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The Playwright desktop channel requires installing Playwright (npm) inside the actual plugin directory, and OpenAPI features need separately configured Client ID and API Key credentials.
motivation: The author states it is a free open-source project meant to help people who use both 得到大脑 and Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import or stay in sync with notes stored in the 得到大脑 (Get Notes) cloud service.

requires.name: OpenAPI Client ID and API Key

summary: Syncs 得到大脑 (Get Notes) cloud notes, knowledge bases, blogger content, and live transcripts into Obsidian with incremental and two-way sync.
